note: Team gold set. Drafted from the challenge brief, participant README and corpus text; to be verified line by line by the team's lawyer before use. Not legal advice. 'verify' flags the field most likely to be wrong.

rules.title: Tenant Protection Act rent cap
rules.key_value: 5% + CPI, max 10% per 12 months
rules.coverage_conditions: Residential units; certificate of occupancy more than 15 years old
rules.exemptions: Housing with COO within previous 15 years; single-family homes owned by natural persons (with notice); units already under stricter local rent control
rules.interaction: Yields to stricter local rent control (SF, LA, Berkeley, Santa Ana) -> 'superseded' there
rules.verify: Exemption list wording; sunset date (statute currently sunsets 2030)

rules.title: Tenant Protection Act just cause
rules.key_value: Just cause required after 12 months' continuous occupancy
rules.exemptions: Mirrors §1947.12 exemptions; local just-cause ordinances that are more protective govern
rules.verify: Relocation assistance amount (one month's rent) and 24-month rule where tenants added

rules.title: Security deposit cap (AB 12)
rules.key_value: 1 month's rent; 2 months for qualifying small landlords
rules.exemptions: Landlord is a natural person/LLC of natural persons owning no more than 2 residential properties with no more than 4 units total -> 2 months (not if tenant is a service member)
rules.interaction: Owner type is not in the address data -> result must be 'unknown' for the small-landlord exception, except where units > 4 makes the exception impossible
rules.verify: Exact small-landlord thresholds

rules.title: Application screening fee cap
rules.key_value: Actual out-of-pocket cost, capped at CPI-adjusted statutory amount; no fee when no unit is available
rules.exemptions: Fee waived or refunded where no unit available / applicant not screened (as amended)
rules.verify: README: no single official 2026 dollar figure -> key_value should stay a formula; check latest amendment (AB 2493) refund rules

rules.title: Source-of-income protection (SB 329)

rules.verify: Effective date 2020-01-01

rules.title: Common pricing algorithm restrictions (AB 325 / SB 763)

rules.coverage_conditions: Statewide, all sectors incl. rental housing
rules.citation: Cal. Bus. & Prof. Code § 16700 et seq., as amended by AB 325 (2025)
rules.verify: Exact code sections added; T1 expects 'not_yet_effective' at 2025-12-31 and 'applies' at 2026-01-02
